notes: PyQGIS is every server-declared surface crossed with every function that client can perform. The functions are the QGIS scripting column set: connect/discover, add, render, identify, query/filter, edit, raster read, save/reopen (save layer, save project, save package, reopen), and the auth modes anonymous, token, api key, portal sign-in and pki. A function that does not apply to the surface, or that PyQGIS has no client for, is not-applicable with a declared reason and is not a supported pass. Preview and experimental surfaces stay outside the supported denominator, so a function that would otherwise be applicable there is not-applicable for that reason. Remote processing, branch versioning and attachment editing are dropped functions: PyQGIS has no client, and each is declared not-applicable rather than omitted.
